title: MARS Policy: Multimodality Only When It Matters

tldr.en: Learn how much stochasticity to mix with historical priors, then allocate solver steps according to the learned multimodality weights.
tldr.zh: 学习历史先验与随机性的混合程度，并按学得的多模态权重分配求解步数。

evaluation_scope.en: Eight simulated and four real tasks, including Franka Research3 and Galaxea R1 Lite. π0.5 compatibility remains to be checked.
evaluation_scope.zh: 8 项仿真与 4 项真机任务，包括 Franka Research3 和 Galaxea R1 Lite；π0.5 适配情况待核对。
